description: Vendor-neutral conformance vectors for the honest-null discipline (not-known != zero). Record-level rules (3a/3b) are executable here against any implementation's validator; the boundary round-trip (rules 1/2) is a documented contract each implementation runs through its OWN codec. See README.md.

record_level_vectors.note: coherence is an honest null paired with a reason
freshness is an honest null paired with a reason
carbon is not-known (unknown grid), declared with a reason
coherence carries a value AND a nulls entry — pick one
coherence is null but carries no nulls.<signal>.reason
carbon carries a value AND a nulls entry
carbon is null but carries no reason

boundary_round_trip.description: For each positive vector, an implementation MUST round-trip the record through its OWN constructor + wire encode + wire decode and assert the nullable field decodes AS null (not 0) and the reason survives. This is language-specific and not executable from this pack; the contract is in README.md. A conforming implementation ships wire round-trip tests that do exactly this.
